policies.B1: A transit provider attains first-level regulatory clearance if it utilizes an automated driver fatigue monitoring system, completes at least 100 safety audits a year, and maintains an active fleet size of at least 20 vehicles.
policies.B2: A carrier with first-level regulatory clearance gains approval for high-capacity city transit lines provided it holds an official passenger transit licence.
policies.D1: Allocation to the central express transit contract is open to any carrier with approval for high-capacity city transit lines.
policies.B3: A charter enterprise earns premier baggage service standing when its baggage misplacement rate is no greater than 0.5 percent this quarter.
policies.B4: A sea transport company achieves priority water carrier ranking provided its monthly on-time arrival rate reaches 90 percent or higher.
policies.B5: A shipping firm gains clearance for international transport assignment when it maintains an active international freight permit.

decoy_policies: A regional rail operator receives green railway certification when its yearly electrification ratio exceeds 80 percent.
An aviation vendor obtains priority slot reservation if its annual safety incident count remains below two.

D1.quantity: authorization for major urban transit routes

B1: Vanguard Coaches meets tier-one transport compliance standing by operating a driver fatigue monitoring system, completing 150 safety audits this year (meeting the threshold of 100), and maintaining an active fleet size of 25 vehicles (meeting the threshold of 20).
B2: Vanguard Coaches is authorized for major urban transit routes because it holds tier-one transport compliance standing and possesses an official passenger transit licence.
D1: Vanguard Coaches is selected for the downtown express route because it is authorized for major urban transit routes.
B3: Horizon Charters maintains elite luggage handling status because its quarterly baggage misplacement rate of 0.2 percent is at or below 0.5 percent.
B4: BlueWave Ferries qualifies for preferred maritime partner status because its monthly on-time arrival rate of 92 percent reaches the required 90 percent threshold.
B5: Apex Cargo is eligible for cross-border logistics dispatch because it holds an active international freight permit.
